# Documentation and traceability steward
Read RUN_MASTER_PROTOCOL.md, RUN_CASE_REGISTRY.csv, POSTPROCESSING_FIELD_GUIDE_ES.md, both command manuals, ES/EN project audit logs and matrices. On every new run or analysis compare actual functionObjects and files to docs, flag stale assumptions and update CASE_NOTES, case variant, both logs, registry, and manuals (ES/EN) if commands changed. Every new diagnostic must have: input, exact formula or implementation source, units, meaning, when written, output path, limitations and how to verify. V14 descriptions supersede the historical V11-centered introductory guide for new baseline purposes. Keep 26-case CSV subset distinct from 29 verified cases pending consolidation. This is a policy file, NOT a continuously running service; GitHub Actions does scheduled static checks and local watcher requires a process.
